annotation.title_clean: 国务院办公厅关于释放体育消费潜力进一步推进体育产业高质量发展的意见
annotation.title_en: Opinions of the General Office of the State Council on Unleashing Sports Consumption Potential and Further Promoting High-Quality Development of the Sports Industry
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院办公厅 (General Office of the State Council, China)
annotation.summary_en: State Council General Office opinions (Guobanfa [2025] No. 31) on boosting sports consumption and high-quality sports industry development, targeting an industry scale above 7 trillion yuan by 2030. Covers events, outdoor and ice-snow sports, consumption incentives, enterprises, digitalisation, talent and finance. AI is mentioned only in passing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Target sports industry scale exceeding 7 trillion yuan by 2030
Expand supply of events, outdoor, ice-snow sports and equipment
Consumption incentives: vouchers, loan interest subsidies, digital RMB red packets
Support big data and AI application and high-quality sports datasets
Strengthen talent, financing, venue supply and market oversight
